title: Vision Prescription Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Open Dental appointments (`opendental:appointment`), Zocdoc bookings (`zocdoc:booking`), vision prescriptions (`vision:prescription`), dental hygiene visits (`dental:hygiene`), and Withings eye-health checks (`withings:eye`).
app: Open Dental appointment exports, Zocdoc booking webhooks, vision prescription sidecars, dental hygiene visit logs, and Withings Vision eye-health readings streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vision:prescription
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by optometrist
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>720
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when vision prescription data has stopped arriving for a given optometrist.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per optometrist and alert when the feed is older than 720 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your vision prescription feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
